policy.each_claim_requires: A separate authentic capture and independently reviewed web comparison for each claimed feature/model.
policy.minimum_steps: Initial LCD + every keypress + final result/error.

physical device identity and capture date
key sequence and LCD screenshots for each step
web build commit and web screenshots
explicit differences and comparison verdict PASS
